items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

ctx.x: I worked with all of my sisters.
I worked with every one of them. Edna, Artie, and Sadie.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: She said, that's my trumpet player, trumpet player, I said, what's his name?

ctx.x: Let me tell him how I met you. Let me tell him, because he ain't going to tell you that I got told you.

Maybe each one of you got a different story on that. Now, this is the case though. Well, see, when my sister went here Sadie, I was staying with Sadie, I was working around with Lawrence Togel and the different bands going around, you know, just wild, understand? Yeah. Just having my fun. And, I don't know, so I never did see the trouble. I might have seen him, but I wasn't paying no attention, really. I might have been in different places, you know, like we used to go out to what we call those speakeasers and…

items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: It's Billy, but it's not Didi.

ctx.x: . Know this number. You know who that is? It's Billy, but it's not Didi. You know who that is? You know who that is? How did you like that? It sounded good. I knew that, I could tell that. Did anybody else play like that on that auto run there? No. Only Billy. How about let me get another one, cued up on the same record. Okay. How about picking all of them, one of the two?
Billy played with the bands too that came to town then.
